release_notes:
v1.0.12+19 - Pure Peer-to-Peer (P2P) WebRTC Studio Classroom ($0.00/month Unmetered)
- Replaced proprietary Agora RTC with native flutter_webrtc powered by Supabase Realtime broadcast signaling
- High-fidelity acoustic music audio profile (Opus Stereo 48kHz for piano, guitar, and vocal harmonics with unconstrained dynamics)
- Animated Studio Monitor Banner for immediate 1-tap entry when faculty goes live
- Removed legacy agora_rtc_engine binary dependency (drastically smaller APK size and faster loading)
- Director Stealth Proctor & In-App QA Observation support
